defs.def: to defeat sb in a game or competition （在比赛或竞争中）赢，打败（某人）

ex.s: Last week, in a public debate in San Francisco, a software program called Project Debater beat its human opponents, including Noa Ovadia, Israel’s former national debating champion.
ex.t: 上周，在旧金山的一场公开辩论中，一个名为"辩论者项目"的软件程序击败了它的人类对手，包括以色列前全国辩论冠军诺亚·奥瓦迪亚。

ex.s: Six months after suffering our （14）     on the spring practice field， we won our first game and our second， and continued to （15）     ．Finally， we faced the number one team in the state． I felt that it would be a （16）     for us even if we lost the game． But that wasn't what happened． My boys beat the best team in Georgia， giving me one of the greatest （17）     of my life！
ex.t: 在春季训练场遭受（14）___六个月后，我们赢下第一场、第二场，并继续（15）___。终于，我们面对全州第一的队。我觉得即使输了，对我们也是（16）___。但事实并非如此。我的孩子们击败了佐治亚最好的队，给了我一生中最伟大的（17）___之一！

ex.s: He explains that in his entire life, his brother always tries to beat him at everything he does and that it has been a very positive force.
ex.t: 他解释说，在他的一生中，他的哥哥总是试图在他做的每件事上打败他，这成为了一股非常积极的力量。

ex.s: "Throughout my entire life, I've had my brother trying to beat me at everything I do.
ex.t: "在我的一生中，我哥哥总是在我做的每件事上想打败我。

ex.s: I still don’t think that anything can beat my mum’s homemade sausages, though.
ex.t: 不过，我仍然认为没有什么能打败我妈妈的自制香肠。

ex.s: beat humans in international chess matches
ex.t: 在国际象棋比赛中击败人类。

defs.def: to get control of sth 控制
to be too difficult for sb 难倒
to do or be better than sth 比 … 更好；赛过；胜过

ex.s: A machine can now not only beat you at chess, it can also outperform you in debate.
ex.t: 机器现在不仅能在国际象棋上击败你，还能在辩论中胜过你。

ex.s: In the 1980s, the team suddenly became famous in the international volleyball scene with several major world titles, and they beat the United States three to zero in the final of the 1984 Los Angeles Olympics.
ex.t: 20世纪80年代，这支队伍突然在国际排球赛场上声名鹊起，获得了多个重要的世界冠军头衔，并在1984年洛杉矶奥运会决赛中以三比零击败了美国队。

defs.def: to avoid sth 避免；逃避
to hit sb/sth many times, usually very hard 敲打；锤砸

ex.s: It’s a pretty hard combination to beat.”
ex.t: 这是一种很难超越的组合。

defs.def: to make, or cause sth to make, a regular sound or movement （使）规律作响，作节奏运动
to mix sth with short quick movements with a fork, etc. （用叉等）快速搅拌，打

ex.s: The noise shakes the trees as the male beats his chest and charges toward me.
ex.t: 雄性大猩猩捶打胸口向我冲来的声音震动了树木。

ex.s: Next I broke the eggs into a bowl and beat them quickly with chopstick.
ex.t: 接着我把鸡蛋打进碗里，用筷子快速打散。

defs.def: to change the shape of sth, especially metal, by hitting it with a hammer, etc. 把（金属等）锤成；敲打（成 … ）

ex.s: A few minutes later, when I landed the trick, my friends beat their boards loud, shouting: “ Safe!
ex.t: 几分钟后，当我成功完成那个技巧时，朋友们大声拍板，喊着：稳了！

ex.s: Then I put the tomatoes and the beaten eggs into pan together.  ＂Not that way，＂ my mom tried to stop us but failed.
ex.t: 然后我把西红柿和打好的鸡蛋一起放入锅中。"不是那样，"妈妈试图阻止我们但没成功。

defs.def: to make a path, etc. by walking somewhere or by pressing branches down and walking over them 踏出，踩出（道路）

ex.s: If you’re among the groups of people who are enjoying the mental and physical health benefits of surrounding yourself with plants, don’t beat yourself up if one (or a few!) doesn’t make it.
ex.t: 如果你正在享受身边充满植物所带来的身心健康益处，那么即便有一两株养不活，也不要太自责。

ex.s: Taking responsibility for mistakes is a positive step, but don’t beat yourself up about them.
ex.t: 为错误承担责任是积极的一步，但也不要为此苛责自己。

defs.def: to produce a rhythm by hitting sth many times 敲打出节奏
to put a fire out by beating 扑打灭（火）
to remove sth by hitting it with a hammer, etc. 敲掉；锤平
a single blow to sth, such as a drum, or a movement of sth, such as your heart; the sound that this makes （鼓的）一击；（翅的）一振；（心脏等的）跳动；击鼓声；振翅声；跳动声

ex.s: Andrea Hillier says, “Dance, like the pattern of a beating heart, is life.
ex.t: 安德里亚·希利亚说：“舞蹈，就像跳动的心脏节拍，就是生命。”

ex.s: They have made human body parts, including a beating heart, with 3D printing technology.
ex.t: 他们用3D打印技术制造了人体器官，包括一颗跳动的心脏。

defs.def: a series of regular blows to sth, such as a drum; the sound that this makes 有规律的敲击（声）
the main rhythm, or a unit of rhythm, in a piece of music, a poem, etc. （音乐、诗歌等的）主节奏，节拍
the area that a police officer walks around regularly and which he or she is responsible for （警察）巡逻地段
